study_strategy.warning: Current Kew accepts Prunus serotina var. eximia. The learner keeps one species-level P. serotina canonical entry and teaches var. eximia internally to avoid duplicate black-cherry concepts.

quick_split: P. serotina — deciduous tree, long white racemes, black drupes, dark scaly bark; local var. eximia taught internally.
P. caroliniana — evergreen glossy leaves, short axillary racemes, bitter-almond twig odor; range HOLD.
P. angustifolia — thicket-forming plum with narrow serrate leaves and red/yellow drupes; Hays record introduced, range HOLD.
P. mexicana — existing local plum anchor with showy early white flowers and larger plum fruit.
P. rivularis — existing creek-plum anchor, smaller thicket-forming shrub.
